'''Josh Branson Death Star Plans''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Josh Branson]]
* '''Published:''' September 1997 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Dagobah]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Dagobah: Yoda's Hut]]
* '''Strategy:''' Death Star Plans
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDag Death Star Plans Branson LS 1997.txt |Download]]
